arms.guard_hold: same hold, owner deadline and dual lifecycle; only suppress new snapshots when <=100 ms authority remains

hard_gates: one post-authority observation within 400 ms lifecycle budget
five-field final scorer agreement all sessions

stop_rule: one smoke pair then exactly three fresh matched pairs; no guard sweep and no favorable retries
